summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #403 generation-2 exact head 5f844842b980f7c68cebe0a437cb9b1c8d94947b. External lifecycle invalidation clears harness current before deferred realized.destroy completes, while start gates only on current == nil. A caller can therefore reparent/destroy the old model and immediately acquire a replacement during the deferred cleanup window, temporarily leaving two live RealizedLab runtimes. Add a private cleanup/replacement fence held until successful underlying teardown.
evidence: Exact #403 invalidateExternalLifecycle sets invalidated=true, current=nil, disconnects lifecycle signals, then schedules realized.destroy() with task.defer
Exact #403 start() rejects only when current is non-nil, then synchronously realizes and publishes a new lab; it has no pending-cleanup or generation fence
After an external model reparent or destroy invalidation, replacement acquisition can therefore occur before the deferred underlying runtime/representation teardown executes
Required successor must keep a private replacement fence held across deferred cleanup and release it only after realized.destroy succeeds; teardown failure must remain fail-closed
Controlled destroy/stop/restart ordering, stale-handle fencing, and Studio/server guards should remain unchanged
Canonical CI run 31537665202 and Swarm engine-tests are green on the reviewed head; current static suite does not cover deferred reacquisition ordering
